subject: PROGRAM-ID paragraph
notes: Rule: 'A common program is contained within another program but may be called from programs other than that containing it as stated in 8.4.6' (cite.py --check 11.10.4 -> OK §11.10.4 2)); scope rule §8.4.6.3 2) (--check OK). ResolveVisible rule 3 walks the caller's ancestors and admits a sibling only when sib.Common, excluding the COMMON program itself and its containees unless it is recursive (the §8.4.6.3 2) exception); NestedCallablesOf mirrors it for AS NESTED. Probe probe dir out/probe/program-id-paragraph/gr2.cob at --std 85 and 2023: sibling GR2A calls COMMON GR2C -> 'C' runs; GR2A calls non-COMMON sibling GR2N -> ON EXCEPTION 'N NOT VISIBLE'; non-recursive COMMON GR2C calling itself -> 'SELF NOT VISIBLE'. All match the spec.
